title: Hot Chocolate Chip Cookies
author: Ming-Dao Chia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qhmdt46

steps.title: Gather ingredients
steps.instruction: Collect the following amounts: 2 Tbsp coconut butter, 0.25 cup coconut oil, 12 Tbsp olive oil, 1 cup white sugar, 1 egg, 1 tsp vanilla, a dash each of nutmeg, cinnamon, and allspice, 1.5 cups all‑purpose flour, 0.5 cup hot chocolate mix (incl. sugar), 1 tsp table salt, 1 tsp baking soda, and 200 g milk chocolate chips.

steps.title: Melt coconut fats
steps.instruction: Melt the coconut butter and coconut oil; soaking their containers in hot water for 1–2 minutes works well.

steps.title: Combine wet ingredients
steps.instruction: Add the melted coconut butter, melted coconut oil, olive oil, vanilla, egg, nutmeg, cinnamon, and allspice to a bowl and mix well.

steps.title: Combine dry ingredients
steps.instruction: In a separate bowl, mix the all‑purpose flour, hot chocolate mix, table salt, and baking soda until uniform.

steps.title: Incorporate dry into wet
steps.instruction: Add the dry mixture to the wet bowl while mixing until evenly combined; the dough may be crumbly, which is normal. If unmixed powder remains, add more coconut oil and continue mixing.

substeps.instruction: Add dry mixture to wet bowl while mixing.
If dough remains crumbly, add additional coconut oil until fully mixed.

steps.title: Add sugar
steps.instruction: Stir the white sugar into the dough until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Fold in chocolate chips
steps.instruction: Add the 200 g milk chocolate chips and stir until uniformly incorporated.

steps.title: Prepare baking sheet
steps.instruction: Line a tray with baking paper.

steps.title: Portion dough
steps.instruction: Shape 1.5–2 Tbsp of dough into balls and place on the prepared tray, leaving at least 2 cm between cookies.

steps.title: Cool and serve
steps.instruction: Allow the cookies to cool on the tray for 2–5 minutes before serving; they will firm as they cool. Remove carefully if not serving directly from the tray.
